title: Samvaad
description: AI voice agents that sound human. Places outbound calls from a contact list, holds a natural conversation against a per-campaign goal, extracts what was agreed and writes it to calendar and records, with a human review gate on anything uncertain. Streaming STT → LLM → TTS kept under 800 ms a turn.

title: Cartesian Suite: Karta & Fusion Studio
description: Voice agents that talk and do. Karta drives your desktop from Hindi, Telugu or English speech, behind a policy engine, a kill switch and a red-team suite. Fusion Studio runs Oracle Fusion implementations end to end, from setups and regression tests to reports and cutover, in a Git-like repo.

title: Multi-Agent Finance Automation Platform
description: LangGraph state machines and CrewAI agents automating Credit Memo, Rebill and AP workflows. A supervisor agent routes work to an invoice validator, approvals and notifications with human-in-the-loop checks, over 8 Oracle Fusion Receivables REST APIs, cutting manual processing time by 70%.

title: Ask Badger: Enterprise RAG Assistant
description: Production RAG over 10K+ enterprise documents with hybrid vector and keyword retrieval on Azure AI Search. The LangGraph agent decides when to search, synthesise or escalate, reaching 88% answer accuracy, scored nightly by an LLM-as-judge pipeline.

title: AI Vendor Onboarding Agent
description: End-to-end vendor onboarding with N8n orchestrating email triggers, forms, approvals and Oracle Fusion updates, while LangChain agents classify documents and run compliance checks. Onboarding went from 5 days to same-day for 200+ vendors a month.

title: Oracle Fusion Copilot Agents: Suite of 8
description: Eight enterprise copilots across Finance, Procurement, HR and Customer Service in Microsoft Copilot Studio, with adaptive cards, dialog management, guardrails and entity extraction, each backed by a FastAPI microservice on Azure.

title: AI Evals & Agent Testing Framework
description: A reusable evals framework with 500+ curated test cases, LLM-as-judge rubrics and GitHub Actions regression runs, so every prompt or model change is measured before it ships.
